SYNTHETIC UPPER ENDOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

Findings: The gastroscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
A 12 mm sessile polyp in the gastric cardia was removed with a hot snare.
Immediate oozing from the polypectomy site in the gastric antrum was controlled with two hemoclips for hemostasis.
